SELECT fb.id AS id, fb.title AS title, p.nickname AS authorName, fb.created_at AS createdAt, fb.updated_at AS updatedAt, fb.view_cnt AS viewCnt, fb.author_id AS userId, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM user_like_board ulb WHERE ulb.board_id = fb.id) AS likeCnt, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM free_comment fbc WHERE fbc.board_id = fb.id) AS commentCnt,
fbip.id AS img_id, fbip.saved_file_name AS img_name, fbip.path AS img_path, fbip.size AS img_size, fbip.content_type AS img_contentType FROM free_board fb JOIN user u ON fb.author_id = u.id JOIN profile p ON p.user_id = u.id LEFT JOIN free_board_image_property fbip ON fbip.id = ( SELECT sub_img.id FROM free_board_image_property sub_img WHERE sub_img.board_id = fb.id ORDER BY sub_img.id ASC LIMIT 1 ) WHERE fb.is_removed = false
ORDER BY likeCnt DESC
ORDER BY fb.created_at DESC

SELECT fb.id AS id, fb.title AS title, p.nickname AS authorName, u.id as userId, fb.content AS content, fb.created_at AS createdAt, fb.updated_at AS updatedAt, fb.view_cnt AS viewCnt, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM user_like_board ulb WHERE ulb.board_id = fb.id) AS likeCnt,
pip.id AS author_img_id, pip.saved_file_name AS author_img_name, pip.path AS author_img_path, pip.size AS author_img_size, pip.content_type AS author_img_contentType,
